name: Fullstack FastAPI + React
description: Fullstack com FastAPI backend + React frontend, CORS, JWT auth ready, Docker

files.docker-compose.yml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./app.db
  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    depends_on:
      - backend
files.README.md:
# Fullstack FastAPI + React - P4 Template

Gerado via AI Provider OS Workplace Templates P4 Enterprise

## Run
```bash
# Backend
cd backend && pip install fastapi uvicorn && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
# Frontend
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
# Or Docker

docker-compose up
```

## Features
- FastAPI backend + React frontend
- CORS ready

- Docker Compose
